answer.thought: Hegde sits in the corner, a ghost in his own living room, watching the clock. The air is still, heavy with the unspoken fact that I am a mistake and he is a victim. I am hungry, a fact that the body insists upon with crude persistence, but I have no food and no money to buy it. We are both suspended in the same grey ether, waiting for the state to notice us.
